item.title: Gill Blames Democrats for Partial Shutdown, Says They’re Undermining ICE Deportations
item.description: Congressman Brandon Gill on partial government shutdown: “Democrats are willing to do whatever they can to thwart ICE and stop the President from deporting illegals which is what he was elected to do. They want to turn every city into Minneapolis.”

item.title: Homan Says Trump Administration Has Carried Out Record 700,000 Deportations
item.description: TOM HOMAN: “I looked at the numbers just 15 minutes ago —President Trump has been in office just over a year, and we’ve had over 700,000 deportations between Border Patrol and ICE. That’s a record.”

item.description: A senior Gaza physician whose anguished New York Times op-eds became widely cited touchstones of the war is now at the center of a sharp credibility fight over media vetting, after Israeli officials and a watchdog group exposed that he also held a senior role in Hamas. item.title: Boeing’s MQ-25A Stingray Completes First Autonomous Taxi Test
item.description: Boeing Defense reports that the first operational MQ-25A Stingray completed its initial autonomous taxi test; the carrier-based drone, designed to refuel Navy jets and extend F-35C range, is expected to make its first flight in early 2026.

item.title: WATCH: Snow Blankets Fall Creek Falls in Stunning Tennessee Winter Scene
item.description: A breathtaking winter scene unfolds at Fall Creek Falls in Tennessee, with snow-covered trees framing the rushing waterfall.

item.title: Bill Clinton Criticizes Trump Immigration Crackdown in Video Address to U.S. Mayors
item.description: Bill Clinton delivers a message through a recorded video for the US Conference of Mayors, and talks about freedom, democracy, and the Trump administration’s crackdown on illegal immigration, including the deaths of protesters Renee Good and Alex Pretti by federal agents.

item.title: Qatar PM Meets Iran’s Ali Larijani in Tehran to Discuss Regional De-Escalation
item.description: Qatar’s Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman al‑Thani met in Tehran with Iran’s Ali Larijani to discuss efforts to de-escalate tensions in the region.
